notes: AI-assisted manual review (optional, self-configured endpoint/model/key stored locally). Offline by default; the opt-in version check is read-only, multi-source and never uploads table data. Downloaded bytes must embed TOOL_VERSION >= the announced latest. Version check and download retry silently up to 3 times when every source fails. New in 1.3.7: a lightweight 'Recommend to a colleague' action in the footer copies a short tool description plus the latest-release download link to the clipboard, in all 8 interface languages - no network request, no upload, no page opened. The public repository also gained a README, an up-to-date description and topics. Keeps the feedback guidance card from 1.3.6 and the GitHub Contents API download fallback from 1.3.4. Final answers are always chosen by the native-speaker human reviewer.
